title: Cyberpunk city
description: Thousands of buildings share one indexed cube. Explore a nocturnal city with cyan and magenta windows and luminous streets.
gesture: Drag with a mouse or touch to orbit. Use the wheel or distance slider to zoom (no pinch).
unavailable: WebGPU is unavailable in this environment.
failed: The city cannot perform this operation.
lost: The GPU device was lost. Reload the page to restart.
instancingHelp: One indexed cube contains 24 vertices and 36 indices. Each building adds eight values: position, dimensions, color and pattern. The vertex shader transforms this cube for each instance; one indexed draw submits all buildings.
depthHelp: The camera uses perspective projection. The depth texture determines which building is in front, independent of their order in the buffer. It is recreated only when the render size changes.
proceduralHelp: Windows and street lines are calculated in shaders. Bright color uses no external texture or bloom. Generation is reproducible; changing height updates only uniforms, not instance data.
drawHelp: Two draws per frame: ground and {buildings} buildings. Submitted geometry: {triangles} triangles (12 per building + 2 for ground). This is not a performance measurement.
